title: Bridal Paragliding Tandem Flight & Flight School
specs: Flights can last from 10 minutes to 1 hour depending on lift
Tandem passengers minimum weight 100 lbs, maximum 270 lbs
Solo V course: age 18 to 65 years old, general good health
Maximum weight 270 lbs for Solo V course
P3 course prerequisite: have P2 or equivalent rating, general good health
P4 course prerequisite: have P3 or equivalent rating, general good health
Up to four tandem flights every two hours (weather permitting)
Guests may ride in 4x4 truck to launch if space available, $20 per guest
includes: Theory, kiting, tandem or solo flights in courses
Free kiting harness included in Solo V and Novice P2 courses
blurb: Guests can book tandem paragliding flights including a 4x4 adventure to the launch site and a high flight. Flight school offers courses from beginner to instructor level with theory, kiting, tandem and solo flights. Gear is provided for initial flights, then must be rented or purchased.
extraNote: Full refund if flights cancelled due to weather conditions · Tandem gift certificates expire one year from purchase date · Certificates refundable less $25 · Certificates transferable and exchangeable at no charge · Flights do not operate in rain or high winds · Bridal Falls Landing Zone (HWY Exit 135)
